highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m152 and adds Graphite GPU backend bindings.
highlights_body: The release also adds asynchronous pixel readback and a Silk.NET Vulkan package, while fixing native object lifetimes and improving Nano Server font support.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through Chrome milestone m152
bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer with the m152 release, servicing fixes, and an upstream use-after-free fix.
Exposes Graphite backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn so applications can use Skia's newer GPU rendering architecture.
Adds backend-neutral RequestReadPixels support on SKImage and SKSurface for asynchronously retrieving pixels.
Prevents use-after-free failures when iterating regions or creating pixel-map subsets, and releases raster pixel memory when image creation fails.

bullets.lead: Runtime-effect uniform buffers released on reset
bullets.detail: Disposes the previous uniform buffer when SKRuntimeEffectUniforms is reset, preventing native memory from accumulating.
Avoids unnecessary copies when saving SKData and removes avoidable allocations while extracting encoded text and formatting four-byte tags.

bullets.lead: Faster runtime-effect and handle lookup paths
bullets.detail: Reduces setup and reflection overhead when looking up runtime-effect uniforms and managed handles.

bullets.lead: Vulkan and Nano Server packages expanded
bullets.detail: Restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server.

bullets.lead: Native debugging symbols packaged for Apple platforms
bullets.detail: Produces Apple native symbol packages during packing to improve symbol availability when diagnosing native issues.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Improved initialization of the MSVC environment for Windows native builds
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Skia m152 update, Graphite GPU backend bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and the Vulkan Silk.NET package.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added lifecycle fixes, native symbol packaging improvements, and further m152 servicing updates.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves shaping and tag-formatting performance, and releases temporary stream assets after creating HarfBuzz blobs.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m152 renderer and Graphite GPU backend bindings.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also adds asynchronous pixel readback APIs and the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 adds m152 servicing updates and lifecycle fixes.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: The candidate also improves native symbol packaging for Apple platforms.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 delivers the Skia m152 renderer, Graphite bindings, and asynchronous pixel readback.
v4.152.0.body: It also improves native object lifetimes, Vulkan package support, and Nano Server font handling.
